factory-board.description: The Factory board by movement and the one card at three sizes (PRD factory-board-cards): the board window, the graph with small cards, and every kind of card at the small, normal and wide widths.

states.board: 보드: four lanes by movement, 시작 전 · 진행 중 · 멈춤 (나를 기다림, 다른 걸 기다림) · 완료, with the narrow lanes drawing their cards small and old completions folded.

judgment: Does the eye land on the title, the one colored state icon, the problem line and the left band first, with everything else small and gray?

Does each size drop the less important parts first: small keeps the numbers, logo, icon and a two-line title; normal adds the summary, bar, problem and one button; wide adds the second summary line, the state word with the worker mark, the other buttons and the ✦ line?
Is 멈춤 the one lane to look at, with 나를 기다림 above 다른 걸 기다림, and do the narrow 시작 전 and 완료 lanes read as quiet?
Does the hatched current cell read as stopped at that stage without a word, in Light and Dark?
Long Korean titles and long English identifiers: does each size cut them at its line count without overlap, breaking Korean between words rather than inside one?
